entries.description: Minimal Dockerfile for a FastAPI backend started with uvicorn. Base image: python:3.11-slim. WORKDIR /app. Copies requirements.txt first, runs pip install --no-cache-dir, then copies full source. Sets PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1, exposes port 8000. CMD: sh -c uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000.
decision_rules: Use python:3.11-slim to keep image size minimal
Set PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 so log output is streamed immediately to stdout
tradeoffs: No multi-stage build — image includes pip and build tools, larger than distroless variants
No non-root USER defined — extend with USER directive for production hardening
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode secrets in ENV or ARG instructions inside the Dockerfile
Do not COPY . . before COPY requirements.txt — breaks Docker layer caching
